description: Running EC2 Instances Share an SSH Key Pair Name (Review)
rationale: More than one running instance in a Region references the same EC2 KeyName. Common key names can be deliberate for autoscaling fleets and do not prove shared private key files, open SSH access, or compromise.
remediation: Confirm the intended key lifecycle and administrative access; consider SSM Session Manager or scoped individual identities instead of distributing reusable private keys.
